sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Boiling Water (Level 2). At altitude, boil 3 minutes. Pre-filter through cloth to remove sediment — saves fuel.
📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 2). Cold smoking (under 90°F) preserves without cooking. Jerky done right lasts months.
📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 3 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Oscar Simpson. Chef. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Beat-up Paperback, Mixtape, Knife roll, Home key, Dog tags. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing.
A man, maybe 50s: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
— DAY 1 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 19L left.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s, with tattooed arms says. (Trust too low.)
📋 A man, maybe 20s wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
A person, maybe 30s, with tattooed arms heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A person, maybe 20s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek wanders off. "I want to see what's out there."
A man, maybe 50s heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A man, maybe 20s wanders off. "I want to see what's out there."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A woman, maybe 40s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A woman, maybe 20s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A man, maybe 40s heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 30s, with tattooed arms looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s, with tattooed arms says. (Trust too low.)

💧 A woman, maybe 20s returns with water: +2 clean.

"Hey." A woman, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.

★ IDENTIFIED: Hawthorn. A thorny shrub/small tree with clusters of small red berries. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
